_comment: Ceremony depth per change class — the one table road-to-a-step-that-costs-what-it-changes 2.2 names. The class comes from src/scripts/classify_change_risk.ts, raise-only. `mode: shadow` lowers nothing; `step_receipt` reports what a lowered depth WOULD skip. The owner decided on 2026-10-21 (agents/evidence/owner-directives/2026-10-21-review-cap-and-depth-flip.md, option (d)) that a lower depth may apply only inside `flip`: R0/R1 steps whose every path is structurally safe (src/scripts/_lib/depth_flip.ts), and only once a committed reading (`flip.reading`) shows `flip.requires` met per class. Setting `mode: active` without that reading is refused by tests/scripts/step_receipt.test.ts. A class whose sampled full-depth audits (src/config/depth-audit-samples.json) break the same threshold returns to full depth automatically.

full.review: rounds until the completion review passes (plan-review-gates § 2.5)
full.council: on any open question the run cannot settle from the tree (roadmap-process-loop § 5 step 4)
full.evidence: an analysis or review artefact under agents/evidence/
full.revalidation: council on a stale or drifted plan

R2.review: full, under road-to-a-review-that-ends' round cap once it lands
R2.revalidation: deterministic stale check; council only on detected drift

R3.review: full, plus a parallel independent seat
